items.title: Migrating the GitHub Copilot runtime to Rust, using Copilot
items.content:
A rewrite this size wasn't affordable before agents. Here's what porting the Copilot agent runtime to 800,000 lines of production Rust actually took.

The post Migrating the GitHub Copilot runtime to Rust, using Copilot appeared first on The GitHub Blog.
items.contentSnippet:
A rewrite this size wasn't affordable before agents. Here's what porting the Copilot agent runtime to 800,000 lines of production Rust actually took.
The post Migrating the GitHub Copilot runtime to Rust, using Copilot appeared first on The GitHub Blog.
items.creator: Stephen Toub

summaries.zh: GitHub将Copilot运行时迁移至Rust，利用Copilot完成迁移。此次重写规模庞大，在引入代理之前难以实现。文章详细介绍了将Copilot代理运行时迁移至80万行生产级Rust所耗费的工作量。
summaries.en: The GitHub Copilot runtime has been migrated to Rust, a 800,000-line production codebase. This rewrite was previously unfeasible but became possible with the introduction of agents. The article details the process and outcomes of porting the Copilot agent runtime to Rust. (Word count: 50)

items.title: Project HydraFusion: Frontier quality via multi-model orchestration
items.content:
In controlled offline evaluations, HydraFusion’s selective coding workflows matched or exceeded the evaluated Opus 5 baseline while reducing estimated workflow cost. Now available as a research preview in GitHub Copilot.

The post Project HydraFusion: Frontier quality via multi-model orchestration appeared first on The GitHub Blog.
items.contentSnippet:
In controlled offline evaluations, HydraFusion’s selective coding workflows matched or exceeded the evaluated Opus 5 baseline while reducing estimated workflow cost. Now available as a research preview in GitHub Copilot.
The post Project HydraFusion: Frontier quality via multi-model orchestration appeared first on The GitHub Blog.
items.creator: GitHub Staff

summaries.zh: 项目HydraFusion通过多模型编排实现前沿质量。在离线测试中，其选择性编码工作流程表现与Opus 5基准持平或更优，同时降低了工作流程成本。该项目现已在GitHub Copilot中作为研究预览发布。
summaries.en: Project HydraFusion achieves frontier quality through multi-model orchestration. Offline evaluations show its selective coding workflows match or exceed Opus 5 baseline performance while reducing workflow costs. It is now available as a research preview in GitHub Copilot.

items.title: How we make AI coding more cost efficient without sacrificing task quality
items.content:
Why shorter outputs can cost more, and how GitHub Copilot reduces wasted work across the complete coding task.

The post How we make AI coding more cost efficient without sacrificing task quality appeared first on The GitHub Blog.
items.contentSnippet:
Why shorter outputs can cost more, and how GitHub Copilot reduces wasted work across the complete coding task.
The post How we make AI coding more cost efficient without sacrificing task quality appeared first on The GitHub Blog.
items.creator: Erik Kristensen

summaries.zh: 本文探讨了如何通过GitHub Copilot提高AI编码的成本效率，同时不牺牲任务质量。文章指出，较短的输出可能因重复请求而增加成本，而GitHub Copilot通过优化整个编码流程，减少了不必要的重复工作，从而降低了总成本。
summaries.en: GitHub Copilot enhances AI coding efficiency by reducing wasted work and optimizing task completion without compromising output quality. The article explains that shorter outputs can sometimes incur higher costs, and Copilot addresses this by streamlining the entire coding process. This approach ensures cost-effectiveness while maintaining high-quality results. For more details, see "How we make AI coding more cost efficient without sacrificing task quality" on The GitHub Blog.

items.summary: 本文探讨了如何通过GitHub Copilot提高AI编码的成本效率，同时不牺牲任务质量。文章指出，较短的输出可能因重复请求而增加成本，而GitHub Copilot通过优化整个编码流程，减少了不必要的重复工作，从而降低了总成本。
